## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: why_trace returns the blame, commit, change-id and decision chain for a...

The system SHALL ensure that why_trace returns the blame, commit, change-id and decision chain for a fixture repository, and an explicit empty result when no decision record covers the line.

#### Scenario: why_trace returns the blame, commit, change-id and decision chain for a...

WHEN `add-why-mode-to-explain-code-with-epistemic-tiers` is implemented
THEN why_trace returns the blame, commit, change-id and decision chain for a fixture repository, and an explicit empty result when no decision record covers the line.

### Requirement: The explain-code SKILL documents the tier vocabulary and the null-result and...

The system SHALL ensure that the explain-code SKILL documents the tier vocabulary and the null-result and embedded-hypothesis rules; no standalone /why skill is added.

#### Scenario: The explain-code SKILL documents the tier vocabulary and the null-result and...

WHEN `add-why-mode-to-explain-code-with-epistemic-tiers` is implemented
THEN The explain-code SKILL documents the tier vocabulary and the null-result and embedded-hypothesis rules; no standalone /why skill is added.

### Requirement: evidence_level is optional in review-findings.schema.json, appears in the...

The system SHALL ensure that evidence_level is optional in review-findings.schema.json, appears in the prompt contract derived by review_findings_schema.prompt_contract, and every existing emitter still validates; the schema diff is limited to that one field.

#### Scenario: evidence_level is optional in review-findings.schema.json, appears in the...

WHEN `add-why-mode-to-explain-code-with-epistemic-tiers` is implemented
THEN evidence_level is optional in review-findings.schema.json, appears in the prompt contract derived by review_findings_schema.prompt_contract, and every existing emitter still validates; the schema diff is limited to that one field.
